DIAGNOSIS READY: Insect Bite Hypersensitivity (likely fleas or bedbugs).

The linear arrangement of red papules ("breakfast, lunch, and dinner" pattern) on your limbs, combined with excoriations from scratching and normal blood counts, strongly points to an insect bite reaction rather than scabies (which showed no mites).
